description: Today's open todos from Workflowy, in the bar. Click one to complete it, type to capture a new one.

schema.label: All tab: cache lifetime (seconds)
schema.description: The All tab reads the whole-account export, which Workflowy limits to one request per minute. Below 60 the limit refuses and the cached list is shown instead.

schema.label: Skip subtrees named
schema.description: Comma-separated. A recurring template can stamp a dozen empty section headers into a day; name its parent here to keep them out.
